ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Teams Application Related ObjectAcess Event
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects an access to authentication tokens and accounts of Microsoft Teams desktop application. Note: Unmapped fields: ObjectName, ProcessName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4663 AND (ObjectName = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Teams\\\\Cookies.*") OR ObjectName = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Teams\\\\Local\\ Storage\\\\leveldb.*"))) AND  NOT (ProcessName = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Teams\\\\current\\\\Teams\\\.exe.*"))
